description: This file defines API routes for managing notes using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting notes, and listing note history, with search and filtering features.

methods.name: _apply_search_filters(query, search: Optional[str], tags: Optional[List[str]])
methods.description: Applies search and tag filtering to a SQLAlchemy query.

methods.name: PagedNotes list_notes( page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=200, description="Items per page"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search text across title and content"), tags: Optional[List[str]] = Query(None, description="Filter notes containing any of the specified tags"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists notes with optional search, tag filters, and pagination.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a new note and stores initial history.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Updates a note and records its previous state in history.

methods.name: None delete_note(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Deletes a note and its history.

methods.name: List[NoteHistoryOut] list_note_history(note_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Lists historical snapshots of a note.
